paper_title: MADLLM Multivariate Anomaly Detection via Pre-trained LLMs
caption: : F1 score results
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the F1 score (%) for three variants of the MADLLM model across five different datasets: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, and MSL. The horizontal axis displays these five datasets in alphabetical order, while the vertical axis represents the F1 score in percentage, scaled linearly from 80 to 100 with tick marks at intervals of 10. The chart contains three grouped bars for each dataset, distinguished by color: light green for MADLLM, purple for MADLLM w/o feature embedding, and orange for MADLLM w/o skip embedding. For each dataset, the light green bar (MADLLM) is consistently the tallest, followed by the purple and orange bars, which are visually similar in height to each other but generally shorter than the green bar. Specifically, for SMD, the scores are approximately 93% (green), 90% (purple), and 90% (orange); for PSM, they are approximately 97% (green), 93% (purple), and 93% (orange); for SWaT, they are approximately 91% (green), 86% (purple), and 86% (orange); for SMAP, they are approximately 93% (green), 90% (purple), and 90% (orange); and for MSL, they are approximately 93% (green), 90% (purple), and 90% (orange). The bars are not sorted and no individual bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding.
